create.name: Christine Stevens
create.bio:
Christine Stevens is a music therapist, author and drum circle facilitator who teaches drumming and the Native American-style flute as spiritual and sound-healing practices. She holds master's degrees in music therapy and social work, founded UpBeat Drum Circles, and has led drum circles for companies, communities, disaster survivors and refugee women, including the first drum circle peace training in northern Iraq. After more than a decade of singing Lakota prayer songs and taking part in Hanbleceya, she was adopted into a Native American family by Uncle Manny Eagle Elk Council Pipe Sandoval, and she is a pipe carrier for Women's Way Long Dance.

Her teaching uses hand drums, frame drums, voice, crystal bowls and flute, often played outdoors at sacred natural sites, with an emphasis on improvisation, ceremony and reciprocity with nature. She runs online courses and trainings, the monthly Global Rhythm Sangha, and a series of self-paced flute and drumming courses on The Shift Network. Her books include Music Medicine, The Healing Drum Kit, The Art and Heart of Drum Circles and The Nature Sutras. She is based in Encinitas, California.

books.title: Music Medicine: The Science and Spirit of Healing Yourself with Sound
books.author: Christine Stevens
books.description: Christine Stevens' guide to using rhythm, melody, harmony and silence as personal practices, with a foreword by Joan Borysenko. It is organised around the four directions and elements and includes exercises with drum, voice and listening.

books.title: The Art and Heart of Drum Circles
books.author: Christine Stevens
books.description: A practical guide to facilitating drum circles, now in its second edition from Hal Leonard. It covers rhythms, facilitation techniques and ways of building community through group drumming.

courses.title: Deepen Your Flute Journey
courses.description: A ten-module self-paced course for playing the Native American-style flute as spiritual practice and sound healing, with no music reading needed. It covers scales, improvisation, composition, ornamentation and making a simple flute, and includes The Flute as Sound Medicine.

courses.title: 7 Scales for the Native American Flute to Create Joy, Musical Magic & Spiritual Growth
courses.description: A self-paced course exploring seven scales from different world traditions on the Native American-style flute. Each session focuses on one scale through guided practice, with no music reading required.

courses.title: Awakening Through Sound
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand course in improvising on the Native American-style flute to build confidence and quiet the self-critical mind. It includes a guest session with flautist Mary Youngblood and play-along tracks.

courses.title: The Flute as Sound Medicine
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced introduction to the Native American-style flute for mindfulness and self-expression. It covers the flute's history, pentatonic melodies, improvisation and heart-centred practice, with a handbook and play-along tracks.

courses.title: Beginner's Native American Style Flute Course
courses.description: A six-video beginner's course in playing the Native American-style flute for spiritual practice, self-expression and connection to nature. Ten per cent of proceeds go to a Native-run non-profit.

courses.title: How to Facilitate Healing Drum Circles
courses.description: UpBeat Drum Circles' eight-module online facilitation training for leading drum circles, with bonus materials and a certificate of completion. It teaches rhythm games, facilitation skills and ways to use drumming for wellbeing in groups.

courses.title: Zoom Lab: How to Lead Drum Circles Online
courses.description: A short online course for facilitators on running drum circles and rhythm programmes over Zoom. It covers set-up, sound and ways to keep online groups engaged.

free_resources.title: Four Essential Rhythms of Life
free_resources.description: A free two-part video training that teaches four rhythms in a guided drumming practice of under ten minutes. No musical experience is needed, and a PDF handout is included.

free_resources.title: 3 Tips for Playing Native Flute for Sound Healing
free_resources.description: A free three-part video training, filmed outdoors near Joshua Tree, with tips for playing the Native American-style flute. It includes a space-blessing practice and two downloadable backing tracks.

flags: Her accounts are branded UpBeat Drum Circles (her company), not her own name; counted as hers.
Native American ceremony (Lakota songs, Hanbleceya, pipe carrier) is described from her own published bio; subject 'shamanism' is an approximation, so a human may prefer another.
Music Medicine kept: subtitle says 'Healing Yourself with Sound' but names no condition; the publisher's blurb wasn't readable, so check it for health claims.
The Flute as Sound Medicine kept: Shift copy says 'your grief, fears, and pain move through and out of you' (emotional, borderline).
Her Shift bio cites a pilot study reporting reduced pain during COVID-19; left out of the bio.
Connection: Fredy Puma Quispe Singona (another sprint teacher) teaches a session in her Global Rhythm Sangha.
left_out: Shift courses with health claims in their copy: Sacred Language of the Drum (immune system, depression), Improvisational Flute for a Higher Purpose ('antidote for depression'), The Healing Flute ('working with trauma', health crisis), Drumming & Sound Healing (cancer patients, immunity, DNA), Awaken Your Healing Rhythms (pain, trauma, anxiety, inflammation), Awaken Your Rhythm (pain, immunity, Parkinson's).
How to Play Drums for Healing (Teachable): research claims about reducing pain.
Global Rhythm Sangha 2026 and Supervision & Mentoring Program 2026: year-dated programmes nearly or entirely past.
Four Keys to Marketing course: business, not spiritual teaching.
The Healing Drum Kit: Amazon /dp/1591792789 returned an error, not verified. The Nature Sutras: no Amazon listing found (seems to be a poem collection).
COVID-titled meditation videos (dated), and percussion-only lesson videos (strumstick, darbuka, body percussion).
